svg.title: JacoPy file map (1/2): core, proof, interface
svg.text: JacoPy file map (1/2): core, proof, interface
Under jacopy/, generated from the code (2026-10-14, commit 9a11e9b).

Each card is a folder (header right: modules · total lines); rows are module files and line counts. Bold = __init__.py (package facade), gray italic = compatibility alias for an old path. Red number = module over 1,000 lines.
simplification passes valid in every geometry
building an engine from a user question, axiom pack
numerical refuter: testing on concrete models
Small colored square on a row: the module's layer differs from the folder card's layer (e.g. jacopy/bibliography.py is in the foundation layer).
